title: Modeling and Control for UAV with Off-center Slung Load
selection_reason: The complete primary manuscript exposes the paper's three-dimensional suspension-point-acceleration middle loop and reported gains. It is the shortest faithful path to the frozen three-axis acceleration authority, uses available causal state, and does not require obstacles, perception, multi-UAV coordination, direct thrust, or torque authority.
priority_1_disposition: The TITS 2025 article was audited first, but no legal public full text or author manuscript was found; OpenAlex reports closed access and no repository full text. Its abstract was not used to invent equations.
v2_history_disclosure: A planar V2 adaptation of the same paper family closed with no win. That evidence is retained as a risk; no V2 parameters, ranking, or performance are reused for V3 selection.
